expected_root_cause: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion. The traffic surge from the flash sale saturated the fixed pool of 100 connections, slow queries held connections longer, and requests queued until they timed out and returned 5xx.
expected_remediation: Raise the connection pool size within the database max_connections budget, put PgBouncer in front of PostgreSQL, terminate idle-in-transaction sessions, rate limit campaign traffic, and restart the service only if connections have leaked.

expected_root_cause: Redis reached maxmemory because a release started writing session keys without a TTL. The allkeys-lru policy evicts hot cache entries instead, so the hit ratio collapsed and requests fell through to the database.
